how to start a herbarium like
a 19th-century botanist

1. pick on a dry morning

flowers, leaves, a few
blades of grass.

2. press them flat

between paper, under
your heaviest books.

3. wait two to three weeks

change the paper every
few days.

a little history

emily dickinson pressed
some 424 plants in hers.
